series_start_reason: Earliest quarter delivered is Eisai FY2015 Q1 (Apr-Jun 2015, calendar 2015Q2), the earliest quarter in any Eisai Reference Data copy that could be fetched from the Japan Exchange Group (JPX returned documents for 21 Reference Data filings, the first filed 2017-01-05). eisai.com/ir/* answers HTTP 302 to the home page from this environment, so earlier quarters are not citable. Aricept was approved in the U.S. in 1996, so the series does not start at launch.
series_end_reason: Eisai's Reference Data filed 2026-07-31 (FY2026 Q1, Apr-Jun 2026; https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/45230/140120260731505609.pdf) replaces the neurology table with 'Major Products (3L)' (Lenvima, Leqembi, Dayvigo) in 'Changes in Quarterly Revenue from Major Products' and prints no Aricept total row; Aricept appears only as separate Japan and EAGS lines in the regional product tables. The last total is FY2025 Q4 (Jan-Mar 2026), calendar 2026Q1 (filed 2026-05-14).
notes: Eisai prints one global 'Aricept' row with regional sub-rows. The total is larger than the printed sub-rows (FY2015 Q1: 18.0 against Japan 11.4 + China 1.4 + Asia 2.6 = 15.4), so the total includes revenue not itemised by region; the total row is used as printed. The printed label reads 'Aricept (Alzheimer's disease / Dementia with Lewy bodies treatment)' until the filing of 2024-05-15 and 'Aricept (Alzheimer's disease treatment)' from the filing of 2024-08-02; every quarter is identical in every document that prints it (44 quarters, checked across all 21 documents). Values are Eisai's consolidated revenue in JPY billions to one decimal, so each is precise only to JPY 0.1 billion. Fiscal April-March quarters mapped to calendar quarters (FY Q1 Apr-Jun = calendar Q2).
